cases.title: timestamp 32 at Unix epoch
cases.paragraph: timestamp 32 is fixext 4 (0xd6) + type 0xff + 32-bit seconds.
cases.notes: Libraries may yield datetime, Timestamp, or ExtType. Accept-only.

cases.title: timestamp 64 with nanoseconds
cases.paragraph: timestamp 64 is fixext 8 (0xd7) + type 0xff + 30-bit nsec and 34-bit sec.
cases.notes: Payload bits are defined by the spec; accept that the value decodes.

cases.title: 2017 is additive: fixstr still works
cases.paragraph: The 2017 revision does not change the str family.

cases.title: 2017 is additive: bin 8 still works
cases.paragraph: The 2017 revision does not change the bin family.

cases.title: timestamp 32 with a short payload is invalid
cases.paragraph: fixext 4 requires four data bytes after the type byte.

cases.title: 0xc1 is still never used
cases.paragraph: 0xc1 is reserved.
